description: SSH opened to the whole internet on the database security group.
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -8,4 +8,11 @@
     protocol        = "tcp"
     security_groups = [aws_security_group.app.id]
   }
+
+  ingress {
+    from_port   = 22
+    to_port     = 22
+    protocol    = "tcp"
+    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
+  }
 }
